objective: Add a local Cloud IaC Helm chart signed-image wiring gate that fails closed when chart values and templates stop preserving digest/cosign render inputs used by the hardened Argo CD Application templates.

best_practice_sources.what_it_establishes: Helm chart templates access values from values.yaml and overrides through the .Values object; this ChangeSet validates local .Values image digest/cosign references without running Helm.

Argo CD can pass Helm parameters and uses Helm to inflate charts while Argo CD manages application lifecycle; this ChangeSet keeps chart-side inputs coherent for those parameters without Argo CD API calls.
Cosign verification is explicit verification work over container images/artifacts; this ChangeSet preserves chart inputs only and does not claim verification execution.
Kubernetes signed-artifact/image verification requires cosign/admission evidence; this ChangeSet remains local chart wiring and does not claim runtime admission.

implemented_claims: Added a first-class oya gate validate cloud-iac-helm-chart-signed-image-wiring lane and aggregate catalog registration.
The gate checks the Cloud IaC Helm chart root for Chart.yaml, values.yaml, templates/deployment.yaml, and templates/configmap.yaml.
The gate requires image.digest to be sha256:<64 lowercase hex> in values.yaml and requires cosign/promotion policy values to remain present.

The gate requires deployment.yaml to wire .Values.image.digest into the container image reference via @{{ .Values.image.digest }} and to expose cosign/image digest/promotion annotations from chart values.
The gate requires configmap.yaml to expose image_signature_policy and cosign_required from chart values.
The Cloud IaC manifest records this local chart-wiring scope and explicit non-claims.
explicit_non_claims: No Helm CLI rendering, chart install/upgrade, Argo CD API call, Kubernetes API call, live sync/diff/health/prune/self-heal, rollout, rollback, cosign verification execution, image signing, admission-controller execution, provider runtime, OpenTofu plan/apply/state, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, production readiness, hyperscaler readiness, or cloud provisioning is claimed.

Kubewarden as default admission substrate and Pulsar as primary event/messaging substrate are user launch directives for later slices; this ChangeSet is admission/runtime neutral and does not implement those adapters.

API contract single-source-of-truth is a user launch directive for later API/contract slices; this ChangeSet does not modify OpenAPI, Protobuf, GraphQL, or contract generation; GraphQL must be generated/validated from the same shared source as REST/gRPC in that future slice.
false_green_findings_closed: GitOps Application templates could pass signed-image Helm parameter gates while the target Cloud IaC Helm chart stopped wiring image.digest or image.cosign.required into its templates; this gate now fails closed on that local chart drift.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed green.
Aggregate ./bin/oya gate run-all is not claimed green unless freshly rerun and proven.
Actual Helm render evidence remains future work because the local environment has no proven Helm CLI render run for this slice.
Cosign verification/admission evidence remains future work; user direction sets Kubewarden as the default admission substrate and Kyverno as a first-class adapter.
Messaging/eventing implementation remains future work; user direction sets Pulsar as launch primary with Kafka, Redpanda, and RabbitMQ as first-class adapters.

API contract single-source-of-truth remains future work; user direction rejects manually maintained OpenAPI plus Protobuf drift and requires one shared Rust-native TypeSpec-like source that generates or validates REST/OpenAPI, gRPC/Protobuf, and GraphQL SDL/resolver contracts together; GraphQL must not be a separately hand-maintained schema.

findings: Small deterministic local scanner closes a chart-wiring false-green without introducing a YAML/Helm runtime dependency.
Strengthens deployment supply-chain discipline by ensuring Argo CD signed-image parameters still reach chart image and annotation surfaces before any dogfood rollout claim.
Negative test mutates digest image-reference wiring and is rejected; missing manifest scope is also rejected.
CLI prints file/line-fragment diagnostics and reports files/required-lines checked for fast local remediation.
Focused tests, Cloud IaC unit suite, live Cloud IaC gates, fmt/check/clippy, and catalog tests passed.

alternatives_named: Add a local chart-wiring gate now
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: The local chart-wiring gate closes the immediate chart-side false-green while preserving honest non-claims until a Helm render/runtime slice can be claimed.
rejected_reasons: Full rendering is a broader slice and the current environment has no Helm CLI proof.
GitOps-only validation cannot prove chart-side .Values references remain wired.

findings: The gate preserves digest-pinned image wiring and rejects credential-like markers in chart files without touching secrets or tenant data.
Adds bounded filesystem reads over four chart files; no runtime serving path or network I/O is affected.
Improves traceability of signed-image intent in chart artifacts; compliance-grade render/admission evidence remains explicitly unclaimed.
Existing chart content already satisfied the gate, so this hardens the contract without changing rendered workload intent.
Bad chart edits fail locally before later Argo CD/Helm/cosign rollout work depends on malformed signed-image inputs.
ChangeSet is tied to Oya VCS claim, RED/GREEN tests, manifest/tasks, evidence, and audit-chain lifecycle rows.
Used Oya VCS claim before edits, avoided raw git/gh, kept /plan complementary-only, and did not claim production/hyperscaler readiness.
No new dependencies were introduced; dependency-seam is included in closeout verification.

review_findings: No critical/high issue found for local gate scope. Live rendering/signing/admission/Kubernetes verification remains explicitly non-claimed.
